stories.title: DEC urges outdoor fire caution amid elevated wildfire risk

stories.description: Día de Muertos, a Mexican tradition honoring loved ones who have passed, combines ancient customs, religious practices, and creative expressions like face painting and sugar skulls to celebrate life and death.
